We evaluate the performance of all translation directions using the FLo-Res testsets, covering 50 languages from 10 language groups. The performance of translation is measured by the detokenized case-sensitive BLEU score, calculated using the SacreBLEU evaluation script.

Existing multilingual neural machine translation (MNMT) models, such as mBART and M2M-100, have showcased significant advancements to handle multiple translation directions in a single model, especially enabling zero-shot translation directions between languages not encountered during training with implicit cross-lingual transfer.
datasets: German-Chinese parallel corpus (10 million sentence pairs)
